commands.name: suggest-reporting-areas
commands.summary: Autocomplete AirNow reporting area names (e.g. 'Denver-Boulder, CO') from a city name or ZIP fragment

commands.name: geocode-location
commands.summary: Resolve a U.S. city, region or ZIP code to latitude/longitude (x=longitude, y=latitude) for use with get-current-aqi and get-weather

commands.name: get-current-aqi
commands.summary: Get current observed AQI and today/tomorrow forecasts per pollutant for the reporting area nearest a latitude/longitude

commands.name: get-reporting-area-location
commands.summary: Get the latitude/longitude of a named reporting area

commands.name: get-reporting-area-providers
commands.summary: Get the data and forecast provider agencies (with URLs) for a reporting area

commands.name: get-interpolated-pm25
commands.summary: Get the current interpolated PM2.5 AQI and category for a reporting area

commands.name: get-weather
commands.summary: Get current weather (temperature °F, wind, humidity, pressure) at a latitude/longitude

commands.name: get-reporting-area-hourly
commands.summary: Get the last 24 hours of hourly AQI (with dominant pollutant) for a reporting area

commands.name: get-reporting-area-daily
commands.summary: Get the last 30 days of daily AQI (with dominant pollutant) for a reporting area

commands.name: get-site-hourly
commands.summary: Get the last 24 hours of hourly AQI and concentrations per pollutant for a monitoring site

commands.name: get-site-daily
commands.summary: Get the last 30 days of daily AQI and concentrations per pollutant for a monitoring site

commands.name: list-state-aqi
commands.summary: List current observations and forecasts for every reporting area in a state

commands.name: get-state-history
commands.summary: Get daily AQI for ozone, PM2.5 and PM10 for every reporting area in a state on a past date

commands.name: get-top-aqi
commands.summary: List the U.S. reporting areas with the highest current NowCast AQI

commands.name: list-state-alerts
commands.summary: List states that currently have an AirNow notification (e.g. Wildfires) and its alert type

commands.name: search-site
commands.summary: Keyword search of AirNow.gov pages and documents (EPA search, scoped to www.airnow.gov), 10 results per page
